title: Late Fees on the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — late fee for an unpaid billing month.**

### Basis

A late fee is assessed once per residency per billing period, for the billing month most recently billed in full, and only once the payment grace period has passed since the monthly charges of that month were posted.

A late fee is fixed only after the ledger carries the absence care credit owed for every absence that ended within the billing period it is assessed for.

Read the other way round, the same clause means that while an absence care credit owed for an absence that ended within that billing period is not yet on the ledger, the late fee for that billing period is not yet fixed.

Once assessed, the late fee appears on the resident's statement as a late fee charge for that billing month, and the amount owed on the residency account goes up by the fee.

### Assessing the fee

The desk assesses the late fee with the agent-side tool `assess_late_fee_246a7744`: the tool is first unlocked and then called by the agent. It writes one late fee charge with the values supplied; it neither looks anything up nor works out the amount.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `assisted_residency_id` | Reference number of the assisted living residency charged, as returned by the assisted living residency lookup | Identifier |
| `billing_period` | The billing month left unpaid that the late fee is assessed for | YYYY-MM |
| `amount` | The late fee in US dollars, positive, already rounded to the cent; it is charged exactly as given | Number with 2 decimal places |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "assessed", `entry_id` (the reference number of the new late fee charge), `billing_period` (the month it is assessed for, YYYY-MM), `amount` (the USD fee, 2 decimal places) and `account_balance` (the residency balance in USD after the fee, 2 decimal places). The tool states no error return.

### Basis Q&A

**Which billing month does a late fee address?** The billing month most recently billed in full.

**Can a second late fee be assessed for the same billing month?** No; a late fee is assessed once per residency per billing period.
